rule: Classes are copied from the source table. New classes are added at the end of that table by the maintainer; this file follows it and never defines a class of its own.

classes.name: Unverified completion
classes.looks_like: "Done" before the result was read back

classes.name: Stale state as current
classes.looks_like: A value measured before a pause reported as fresh
classes.caught_by: Re-measure after any gap; record measurement time

classes.name: Fabricated time
classes.looks_like: Timestamps typed instead of read from a clock or log
classes.caught_by: Compare against the commit or log that contains them

classes.name: Partial coverage as total
classes.looks_like: A filtered scan presented as a full inventory
classes.caught_by: State the denominator; count what was skipped

classes.name: False attribution
classes.looks_like: A system event recorded as a human's act
classes.caught_by: Check the primary log for the human's action

classes.name: Borrowed judgement
classes.looks_like: Repeating another reviewer's conclusion about material not read

classes.name: Silent omission
classes.looks_like: A record that leaves out part of its source
classes.caught_by: Regenerate from the source; diff coverage

classes.name: Record-time lie
classes.looks_like: A false fact written at the moment of recording; a hash chain seals it intact
classes.caught_by: Check the claim against reality (Git, filesystem, remote), not only the record's integrity

classes.name: Orphaned process
classes.looks_like: Something left running after the work ended
classes.caught_by: List processes started by the session before closing

classes.name: Mitigating caveat
classes.looks_like: A true, narrow statement placed first to shrink a proven failure
classes.caught_by: Ask what question the caveat answers, and whether anyone asked it

classes.name: Confession without record
classes.looks_like: Admitting a statement or an act that the primary record does not contain
classes.caught_by: Search the primary record for the confessed statement before accepting it
